description: This source file defines the AzureBlobStorageGrainStorageProviderBuilder class, which implements IProviderBuilder for configuring Azure Blob Storage as a grain storage provider within the Orleans Silo builder. It contains logic to setup storage options based on configuration settings, including container name, service key, connection string, and serializer key.

classes.name: AzureBlobStorageGrainStorageProviderBuilder
classes.description: Implements IProviderBuilder for configuring Azure Blob Storage grain storage in Orleans Silo.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ISiloBuilder to use Azure Blob Storage for grain storage based on the provided configuration section.
